an6.101:1.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu nibbānaṃ dukkhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.101:1.2: Anulomikāya khantiyā asamannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.101:1.3: Sammattaniyāmaṃ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. 2.
an6.101:2.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu nibbānaṃ sukhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati.
an6.101:2.2: Anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati.
an6.101:2.3: Sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī
